goal: Restore truthful equipped-item secondary stats and enhancement availability in the active Taro gear route, then bind every WeChat preview artifact to the source tree that produced it.
userValue: Players see the verified green stats of their actual equipped variant, can distinguish usable, unavailable and not-yet-verified enhancement categories, and no longer lose current UI work because WeChat DevTools is still consuming a stale dist package.
nonGoals: Do not change the backend, PostgreSQL, Gear Release, resolver contract, SimC worker or production deployment.
Do not synthesize aggregate character stats from incomplete per-item values.
Do not restore the abandoned capabilityFacts or Gear Evidence Registry design.
Do not treat candidate, current-variant, preview or malformed stat data as an equipped-item fact.
Do not merge before the exact source-bound WeChat candidate receives explicit user acceptance.

currentTruth.knownRegression: The checked-in source contained the slot information hierarchy, but apps/mini-taro/dist/weapp was older than current source and the initial equippedSet path did not consume its own explicitly verified variant stats.

mustChange: An initial equipped item displays its own backend itemStats only when statDisplayStatus is exactly verified_variant; edited and community-imported state continues to prefer exact Resolver itemStaticStats.
The enhancement summary distinguishes 可用, 不可用 and 待核验, and disables only categories that all selected items explicitly mark unsupported.
The WeChat build writes a validated wow-build.json and preview refresh rejects output whose source content hash differs from the current build inputs.
The active gear-detail truth and component contracts describe the same visible-fact boundary as the implementation.
mustNotChange: The backend and public payload remain unchanged.
Resolver identity and selectedOptions remain the only commit proof after editing or community import.
Aggregate character attributes remain pending without their complete canonical snapshot.
Candidate and metadata preview stats never become equipped-item facts.
The archived 2026-07-24 editor task and abandoned evidence-registry branch are not cherry-picked or reopened.
riskUnknown: The exact live equippedSet payload may omit verified_variant on some items; those rows must remain 属性待核验 until the backend supplies exact evidence.
WeChat DevTools may be installed but its CLI service may not be available; a verified build alone must not be reported as a completed DevTools refresh or visual acceptance.
evidenceRequired: Red-to-green model and page-contract tests for verified initial stats and enhancement availability.
Node regression tests that stamp valid WeChat identity and reject stale source identity.
Typecheck, Taro tests, UI architecture audit, safe WeChat build and source-identity verification.
Exact source-bound WeChat preview plus explicit user acceptance of the slot facts and enhancement summary.

ownership.factOwner: The backend Resolver and exact equipped-item statDisplayStatus own equipment facts; Taro only renders verified facts and local drafts. The WeChat build scripts own artifact-to-source identity.

engineeringHealth.reason: The correction changes one active WeChat route and the shared build/refresh boundary. Pure presentation helpers, explicit backend status gates, stale-artifact regression tests and source-bound preview verification keep the scope bounded.

acceptanceEvidence: Targeted Taro tests prove verified initial stats render while pending or preview stats do not.
Targeted component and Node tests prove enhancement availability states and stale WeChat artifact rejection.
The candidate dist wow-build.json source hash matches the exact current source inputs before DevTools opens it.
The user explicitly accepts the three frozen real-WeChat items before merge.

decisionLog.decision: The user reported that previously accepted gear UI improvements, including visible green stats, were missing from the latest compile and authorized complete correction.
The correction keeps backend-owned truth: verified_variant is the only initial equipped-item fallback, while edited and imported state continues to prefer exact Resolver itemStaticStats.
WeChat output is no longer trusted from timestamps or Git branch parity alone; preview refresh must validate an embedded source content hash.
